description: Batch website safety check: the full /safe report for several URLs in one call, priced per site and cheaper than single checks. Each result has a verdict (safe, caution, unsafe), a 0-100 score, and evidence-backed flags for TLS, redirects, security headers, mixed content, insecure forms, and domain age, plus a summary count. Useful for screening every link in a search result, email, or document at once. Not charged if no site can be checked. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

urls.description: Absolute HTTP or HTTPS URLs. Priced per unique URL.
